propositions: Model-emitted criteria labels 'sec' and 'documentation' are synonyms of packaged criteria 'security' and 'docs' respectively, but fail to match known criterion IDs and incorrectly fall to default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned routing.

A normalized criteria mapping must check membership against the effective vocabulary (including project overlay) not the packaged index, and must pass through unmapped labels unchanged to preserve open dimensions and project-supplied criteria.

The calibration document embeds the rejected 'constrain reviewer prompt to fixed vocabulary' mistake at five sites and incorrectly characterizes 'sec' as non-tunable and 'project.review-phase-boundaries' as low-data.
After 'documentation' → 'docs' normalization, high-impact docs findings must still surface through impact-aware nit-suppression, while advisory-only docs findings are dropped.
